propositions: Phase 3 remediation proposals lack validation of proposed fixes, allowing unreachable harms and reversals of recorded decisions to reach Phase 4 approval unchallenged

The fifth validity sub-question 'harm_reachable' requires naming concrete triggering inputs and reclassifies findings with unreachable harms from DEFECT to HARDENING, adjusting the validity graded fraction denominator from 4 to 5

The 'prior_decision' check queries git history, ADRs, and docs to detect deliberate reversals and applies a -0.10 validity penalty only when recorded justified decisions are reversed without naming changed evidence

Remediation Phase 3 proposers must become asymmetric: Proposer A researches OSS practices, Proposer B researches this project's record; divergent moves trigger targeted research into whether either approach was explicitly rejected or adopted

Plan items must carry 'evidence_changed' and provenance tags (converged, research-resolved, or no-consensus); no move reverses a recorded decision without surfacing its justification and changed evidence to Phase 4 approval
